specific_objectives: 33.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to state various terminology used and differentiate between Error, Mistake, Negligence and Violation, flight safety, near miss box and accident reporting procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Classroom discussion on terminology differentiation and review of Near Miss Box reporting flowchart
intro_questions: What is the primary goal of flight safety in aviation?
Can you list three common causes of aircraft accidents?
Why is reporting a near miss important for future safety?

development.content:
Definition of Flight Safety
Human Error vs Mistake
Negligence and Violation types
Safety Management Systems

Near Miss Box usage
Accident Reporting Procedure
Chain of Command for reporting
Confidentiality in reporting

Difference between Error and Mistake
Consequences of Negligence
Reporting timelines and forms
Role of trainees in safety

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a mistake and negligence with an example.
Describe the steps involved in filling out a Near Miss Box.
Why must accident reports be submitted within a specific timeframe?
home_assignment_question: Review the Near Miss Box procedure and prepare a brief note on how you would report a hypothetical near miss incident encountered during training.
